title: Energizing Sweet Slovakian Semolina Hash
description: A traditional Slovakian dessert-like breakfast or brunch dish made with semolina and a fermented Korean chili flake called gochujang, perfect for an energy boost.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the semolina, gochujang, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, unsweetened almond milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter onto a greased wooden-board and cook in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing into wedges.
Serve warm topped with a drizzle of maple syrup, chopped almonds, and dried cranberries.
Garnish with additional chopped almonds and dried cranberries, if desired.
Store leftover hash in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat in the oven or microwave before serving.
Note: This recipe is gluten-free and keto-friendly.
